title: Environmental Impact Assessments for Industrial Developments
what_it_is: Environmental Impact Assessments for Industrial Developments

sections.label: Environmental studies for industrial developments
sections.summary: A question asks whether environmental baseline studies or impact assessments are done for all industrial developments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether environmental baseline studies or environmental impact assessments are currently done for all industrial developments.

sections.label: NParks investigating possible breaches
sections.summary: NParks is investigating whether there had been breaches of the Wildlife Act and/or the Parks and Trees Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I have said on 22 February, in the press conference, NParks is currently investigating whether there had been breaches of the Wildlife Act and/or the Parks and Trees Act.

sections.label: Wildlife Act penalties and remaining vegetation
sections.summary: Infringement of the Wildlife Act may attract a fine up to $50,000 or six months' imprisonment, and 13 hectares of vegetated areas remain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For instance, infringement of the Wildlife Act that came into force in June last year, may attract a fine not exceeding $50,000 or imprisonment up to six months, or both.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Thirteen hectares of vegetated areas, which includes the safeguarded green corridor and vegetated buffers along Sungei Pang Sua, remain.

sections.label: Review and EIA framework enhancements
sections.summary: A review of the incident will be undertaken, and MND will implement four announced enhancements to strengthen the EIA framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As Minister Chan Chun Sing had announced on Monday, a review will be undertaken of this incident, to identify gaps and learning points for project management, supervision and execution, as well as inter-agency coordination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In parallel, MND will continue our efforts to strengthen the Environmental Impact Assessment, or EIA, framework, in close consultation with the nature community and partner agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are currently working to implement the following enhancements which we had announced publicly last October, namely: (a) increase the vigour or rigour of our environmental studies through a set of Biodiversity Impact Assessment Guidelines; (b) strengthen our enforcement regime through the amended Wildlife Act; (c) build up local expertise on ecological matters; and (d) make all environmental study reports publicly available, unless there are security considerations.

sections.label: Conserving the Rail Corridor
sections.summary: The entire 24-km Rail Corridor from Woodlands to Tanjong Pagar is conserved for recreation, community activities and nature.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, by conserving the entire 24-km Rail Corridor from Woodlands all the way down South to Tanjong Pagar for recreation, community activities and for nature.

sections.label: Sungei Kadut and Kranji green efforts
sections.summary: JTC set aside 25 of 500 hectares for AFIP's first phase and retained the railway alignment as a green corridor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In JTC's masterplan for Sungei Kadut Eco-district, or SKED, 25 hectares out of 500 hectares was set aside for the first phase of the Agri-Food Innovation Park, or AFIP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For the Kranji site, while a portion of the KTM railway line was re-routed along Woodlands Road in 2015 to allow the entire site to be comprehensively developed, JTC worked with NParks to relook these plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In 2019, they decided to retain the original alignment as a green corridor within the AFIP, even though this meant for JTC that land parcellation for industry would be more challenging.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This effort to retain the original railway line alignment, with additional green buffers on each side amounting to six hectares, along with a linear park along Sungei Pang Sua, is an example of our on-going efforts to balance nature conservation with land planning and development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are very encouraged by the growing nature consciousness among Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This is part of City in Nature – not just quantitative or qualitative or ecological, but also the DNA mainstreamed in Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will be engaging Singaporeans more deeply on this issue as part of our national conversations on long-term land use planning later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will continue to partner the community as stewards of our City in Nature, and we look forward to working together to achieve this vision.

sections.label: JTC found wrongful clearance works
sections.summary: JTC's project manager found the wrongful clearance works on 13 January.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: JTC's project manager found the wrongful clearance works on 13 January.

sections.label: JTC site visit schedule
sections.summary: A schedule requires JTC officers to regularly visit the site.

sentences.speaker: The Ministry for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Yes, there is a schedule where JTC officers are required to regularly visit the site.

sections.label: Joseph Leong, investigations, NParks powers
sections.summary: Joseph Leong was appointed to tighten processes, and NParks and JTC will investigate, with NParks able to take responsible parties to task.

sentences.speaker: The Ministry for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: In addition to that, we have appointed Permanent Secretary Joseph Leong to look at how these processes can be tightened, especially the inter-agency processes.

sentences.speaker: The Ministry for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: On the third question about the stern warning that was issued by JTC immediately to the contractor involved, at this point in time, NParks and JTC will do their investigations and subsequent to that, if there are any other wrongdoings uncovered by NParks' investigations, NParks will have the statutory powers to take the responsible parties to task.

sections.label: URA as planning gatekeeper
sections.summary: URA is the gatekeeper under the Planning Act and related planning legislation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: URA is the gatekeeper with the Planning Act and related planning legislation, as that legislative gateway.

sections.label: Wildlife Act and NParks powers
sections.summary: The Wildlife Act was brought into force, and under section 10 the Commissioner can impose studies, measures and penalties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And so, it is a professional assessment, involves specific understanding of the site and the different considerations, both environmental and human.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And then, in June last year, in a Private Member's Motion by Member Louis Ng, together with agencies, the Wildlife Act was brought into force.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And if Members may recall, some time back there was some question about whether there is legislative teeth for NParks to enforce in relation to biodiversity environmental management and monitoring.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And so, now under section 10 of the Act, there is significant legislative power for the Commissioner to impose the requisite studies, to impose the requisite measures, and penalties are as I have articulated earlier in my speech.

sections.label: Huationg unpaid for over clearance
sections.summary: Huationg has not been paid for the over clearance in January and December.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Huationg has not been paid for the over clearance in January and December.

sections.label: Public interest and project delay
sections.summary: The Minister is asked whether the incident will delay capacity and industrial development, and information was made public on 16 February due to public interest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: And so, does the Minister have any assessment of whether the delivery of this capacity and industrial development will be delayed as a result of this incident?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We made the information public in February, on 16 February as Mr Xie Yao Quan said, because there was public interest in this.

sections.label: Project delay from COVID-19
sections.summary: There will already be a delay in the execution of the project because of COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: On the second point as whether there will be a delay in the execution of the project, there will already be a delay in execution of the project because of COVID-19.

sections.label: Inter-agency process review
sections.summary: Minister Desmond Lee and the speaker asked Permanent Secretary Joseph Leong to look into the inter-agency process to strengthen it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Often, in a complex project, there will be many agencies involved and this is the reason why both Minister Desmond Lee and myself have asked Permanent Secretary Joseph Leong to look into the inter-agency process to see how we can strengthen this.

sections.label: Streamlined process and responsibilities
sections.summary: Permanent Secretary Joseph Leong will help look into a streamlined process with clear lines of responsibilities for parties in complex projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: When a supervisor did not do his job well, we ask the same questions and at the end of the day, we want a streamlined process whereby there are clear lines of responsibilities for each of the parties involved in any complex project.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And that is what Permanent Secretary Joseph Leong will help us look into.

sections.label: Industrial site changed to Nature Park
sections.summary: What was originally planned for industrial purposes has been changed to Nature Park.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: What was therefore originally planned for industrial purposes has been changed to Nature Park.

sections.label: Works require necessary approvals
sections.summary: Works cannot begin until necessary approvals are obtained, which may require detailed studies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Our position from a regulatory and planning point of view is that works cannot begin until necessary approvals have been obtained; and this may require detailed studies.

sections.label: Guidelines or mandatory for developers
sections.summary: A question asks whether the guidelines are mandatory for developers to follow or are just guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could I just ask, whether these are just guidelines or are they mandatory for developers to follow?

sections.label: Biodiversity Impact Assessment guidelines
sections.summary: The Biodiversity Impact Assessment guidelines are described as very comprehensive if the Member has gone through them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As for the Biodiversity Impact Assessment (BIA) guidelines, if Member has gone through them, they are very, very comprehensive.

sections.label: NParks unauthorised tree clearance action
sections.summary: Over the last 12 months NParks did not take action for unauthorised tree clearances in development works, with the last case in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Over the last 12 months, NParks did not take action or did not have to take action for unauthorised tree clearances as part of development works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The last case that NParks pursued was in 2019.

sections.label: Streamlining processes and accountability
sections.summary: Joseph was asked to look into streamlining processes with clearer accountability and responsibility, without necessarily adding layers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Indeed, one of the things that I have asked Joseph to look into is how we can streamline the processes with clearer lines of accountability and responsibility, and this does not necessarily mean adding additional layers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In fact, we should always look for ways to simplify and streamline the processes so that everyone is clear of their respective areas of responsibilities and there can be no doubt.
